Subject: INV-2027-Q2 — routing options and VAT allocation

Hi Jordan / AP team,

Attached is invoice INV-2027-Q2 (net $78,920) for the Q2 usage period. We pulled the invoice under Redwood Inc — note there are two billing entities for your account and we want to confirm which entity will remit to avoid VAT reclassification on your side.

Payment options we can accept: ACH (preferred), domestic wire, or corporate card. If you choose ACH we can send the ACH authorization form to the signer.

Can you confirm:
- Which entity you will route payment from (Novaforge US or Novaforge EU entity)?
- Whether you need a split VAT allocation on the invoice (we can provide line-item VAT breakdown).
- Any required payer paperwork (W-9 / supplier form) so we can include it in the remittance bundle.

If ACH is easiest, we can provide bank details and the completed ACH form and set a final remittance cutoff (we recommend 5 business days from confirmation to get into this cycle).

Attachments: INV-2027-Q2-11234.pdf

Thanks,

- ACH is preferred but we need Redwood's ACH authorization and a copy of Redwood's W-9 before we can submit to our bank.
- Our cutoff for inclusion in the June 15 payment run is Friday, June 11 EOD PT — can you confirm you can provide documents and bank details by then?
